hanuman-idle.edge_note: reached by the mace and tail (figure, not background)

notes: Crowns cut by the source frame. Hanuman (meditating) and Narad's veena touch the top edge of the original video, so they end flat at the top of the clip.
Thin halo ring. A faint painted halo ring stays around Hanuman's crown in the meditating clip — it touches the crown and can't be separated cleanly.
Halo remnants. Narad (meditating) keeps small translucent bits of his glowing halo near the hair in a few frames.
Ram idle edges. Parts of the dhoti outline are slightly stepped in the alpha (soft at phone size), and one seam frame has a faint smudge by the lower-left of the dhoti.
Ping-pong loops. The meditating clips are only 1–2 s long and Narad idle had to stop before the clouds, so they play forward then backward; the tail, garland and cloth visibly reverse direction.
Clouds background. The clouds move a lot, so its 2 s dissolve seam shows a soft double image. The forest seam is hard to spot.
Mahadev Shiv is a still. There is no Shiv animation in the folder, so both Shiv pictures are background-removed stills with a gentle CSS float.
The mala is drawn, not an asset. No mala artwork exists in the folder; the 108-bead rudraksha mala is rendered live on a canvas.
Generator watermark. The background videos carry a tiny watermark in the bottom-right corner; it was left as is (mostly hidden behind the bottom bar).
